Have you noticed any changes in the texture of your skin or any other sensations in that area? Patient: No, the numbness hasn't really caused any trouble with my daily activities or physical therapy. I can still move my knee and do the exercises without any issues. The skin feels normal, just numb in that one area. Doctor: Have you undergone any nerve conduction studies or electromyography (EMG) to evaluate the numbness following the surgery? Patient: No, I haven't had any nerve conduction studies or EMG tests to evaluate the numbness.
